combo_label: Fruit & Veg × 1980s Pop Culture × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Whiskered attic ruffian who rolled a kitten in dough for a roly-poly pudding
Stallone's brooding one-man army, first unleashed in 1982
Curved yellow fruit sold by the hand, spotty when past its best
Norwegian band whose pencil-sketch video sent Take On Me soaring in 1985
Fleece yield of the hardy grey Herdwick flocks she championed
Say-your-prayers wrestling behemoth who slammed his way through the eighties
Barrel-hurling giant ape who kidnapped Pauline in 1981
Impertinent red who pelted Old Brown with riddles and paid with his tail
Disobedient rabbit in blue who gorged on radishes and dodged a rake
Tough outer coat of a watermelon or a hard cheese; bacon's chewy edge
Great speckled gulper that spat out a frog on tasting his coat
Crunchy taproot dangled before donkeys and given to snowmen for a nose
Grapes and tomatoes wear thin ones; rice pudding grows its own on top
Glossy purple teardrop at the heart of moussaka and baba ganoush
